market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH is ~$2,380 on May 6 2026. To dip to $1,500 by Dec 31 2026 requires a ~37% drawdown within ~8 months. ETH historically more volatile than BTC; 30-40% drawdowns occur but typically need a broader risk-off event. With ETF inflows currently supportive, base rate ~15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Crypto-wide drawdown or rotation could pull ETH down faster than BTC.
